name: All-Type Sheet Metal Fab
old_description: We have been in business since 2000 and our office staff and workers have many years of experience.
about:
All-Type Sheet Metal Fabrication, based in Charlotte, North Carolina, has been operating since 2000. The company, formally registered as All Type Sheet Metal Inc., runs from a facility on Woodpark Boulevard. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop fabricates HVAC ductwork for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Core processes include rectangular duct fabrication, spiral duct fabrication, and welded stainless steel and aluminum ductwork. Production is driven by a Vicon fully automated full line coil and a Siro spiral machine. The company also provides design assistance and in-house engineering support. Finished ductwork is shipped directly to job sites from Virginia to Florida using a 26-foot box truck or a 53-foot trailer.

Customers include mechanical contractors, general contractors, and building owners across the Southeast. The company serves residential housing developments, commercial office and retail buildings, and industrial facilities. Projects range from small custom fittings to large-scale duct systems for new construction and retrofit work.

All-Type Sheet Metal emphasizes precision through automated machinery and a fully automated order-tracking system that follows each job from estimate through delivery. The firm highlights reliable logistics with its own fleet and flexible scheduling, along with decades of combined staff experience in duct fabrication.

name: Allcable
old_description: Allcable is your leading distributor for power, signal, lighting, video, voice, and data needs.
about:
Founded in 1983 in Denver, Colorado, Allcable operates as a privately held distributor of wire, cable, and related connectivity products. The company maintains a second facility in Oxnard, California, serving customers from both locations.

Allcable stocks a broad range of products including fiber optic, voice and data, access control, security and surveillance cables, as well as lighting wire and home theater wiring. Beyond distribution, the company provides value‑added custom services such as cutting, striping, dying, printing, twisting, paralleling, and bundling of wire and cable, along with printed tubing, striped wire, and respooling.

The distributor serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across product life cycles from design through full production, as well as contractors in the security, lighting, and home theater markets. Concrete examples include badge‑entry systems, cameras, smoke detectors, door locks, lighting wire in common gauges and colors, and speaker wire, power harnesses, and data cables for residential installations.

Allcable positions itself as a stocking distributor that helps OEMs reduce shipping and inventory costs by consolidating wire and cable sourcing. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver custom‑processed wire and cable quickly to support production schedules.

name: Allied Body Works Inc
old_description: Since 1949, Allied Body has been taking care of the tradespeople who make the world go-round.
about:
Allied Body Works Inc. was founded in 1949 in Seattle, Washington, when Charles Walter Bull and two partners each invested $200 to leave Heiser Body and open a small garage on Fourth Avenue. The business has remained family-owned through four generations, passing from Bull to his son Owen and son-in-law Dick Minice, then to Richard Minice in 1996, and most recently to great-grandson Adam Keane, who purchased the company in February 2023 and serves as president. Headquarters is at 625 South 96th Street in Seattle’s industrial corridor.

The company operates as a full-line truck equipment distributor and upfitter, providing custom fabrication, installation, and repair for light- to medium-duty vehicles. Its shop builds service bodies, dump bodies, platform bodies, flatbeds, contractor bodies, and van bodies, and integrates cranes, liftgates, electrical and lighting accessories, and EV power systems. Allied also offers cargo van interiors, truck side guards (marketed as the Walker Blocker), and a ready-now inventory program through a partnership with Work Truck Solutions.

Customers span tradespeople, commercial fleets, government agencies, construction firms, shipping and distribution companies, and utilities across the Pacific Northwest. Early work included armored cars for Loomis; recent projects include ladder racks, shelving, and door locks for fleet vans (as noted by fleet manager Robert Salamone) and side-guard safety systems for municipal trucks. A dedicated government and fleet account team handles public-sector contracts.

The company emphasizes its family-owned culture as a differentiator, citing a standard of excellence that carries into every build. It highlights quick turnaround to meet deadlines, the ability to execute complex custom plans, and a future-focused mindset that includes safety innovations like the Walker Blocker and green options such as solar integration. The stated mission is to listen to each customer and design a solution that fits their specific operational needs.

name: Allied Plastics LLC
old_description: Innovative Vacuum Thermoforming Services for Durable Plastic Solutions
about:
Allied Plastics LLC is based in Twin Lakes, Wisconsin. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The company specializes in heavy-gauge vacuum thermoforming and custom sheet extrusion, operating 20-plus thermoforming machines capable of producing parts up to 8 feet by 14 feet by 60 inches in thicknesses from 0.060 to 0.55 inches. Its services span single-sheet, twin-sheet, drape, pressure, and sheet-over-sheet forming, complemented by in-house CNC and robotic trimming, die cutting, punching, finishing, hardware installation, bonding, assembly, kitting, inventory management, just-in-time stocking, packaging, labeling, and fulfillment. Engineering support is provided through an internal IDEA Center. Facilities include a 210,000-square-foot manufacturing plant and a 350,000-square-foot combined distribution and manufacturing site.

Allied Plastics serves agriculture, automotive, transportation, packaging and dunnage, medical, construction, lawn and garden, and industrial markets. Examples include weather-resistant housings and bins for agricultural equipment, interior and exterior components for automotive programs, reusable crates and protective packaging for transportation, trays and housings for medical devices, durable guards and enclosures for construction machinery, storage products and plant trays for lawn and garden, and material-handling solutions for industrial environments.

The company emphasizes its integrated model — combining engineering, manufacturing, finishing, and logistics under one roof — to reduce handoffs and improve control over quality and lead times. Senior team members bring more than 30 years of thermoforming experience, and in-house extrusion allows greater control over material performance.

name: Alpha Sheet Metal Works
old_description: Over 80 years in the areas of metal fabrication in a wide range of industries.
about:
Based in Ladson, South Carolina, Alpha Sheet Metal Works has been serving the industrial community for over 80 years. The company is led by President Joseph W. Schady and operates as both a job shop and a contract manufacturer for prototype to medium-volume production.

The shop specializes in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, producing everything from individual parts to complete automated assemblies. Core processes include laser and waterjet cutting, MIG, TIG, and spot welding by certified welders, CNC forming on Trumpf and Durma equipment, and CNC machining. Quality inspection is supported by a Virtek LaserQC system capable of 0.05 mm tolerance and a portable 3D Romer Arm for coordinate measuring and reverse engineering.

Alpha serves customers in defense, chemical, automotive, and environmental sectors, as well as broader commercial, industrial, and military markets. The company emphasizes CAD-CAM programming and design support to move from concept to finished fabrication.

Alpha's stated differentiators center on its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, rapid laser inspection that generates automated reports, and a commitment to continuous improvement and long-term customer relationships. The firm aims to meet or exceed specifications and delivery requirements on every order.

name: Alpine Food Distributing
old_description: Since 1983, Alpine Food Distributing, Inc. has been a leading force in Redistribution, servicing the food distribution industry, proudly serving the Western United States from our base in Portland, Oregon.
about:
Alpine Food Distributing has operated as a family-owned food redistribution company from Milwaukie, Oregon since 1983. Founded to serve the western United States, the business focuses on streamlining the supply chain for food suppliers and distributors across a ten-state region that includes Alaska, Arizona, California, Hawaii, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah, Washington, and western Montana.

The company manages more than 10,000 food products through over 620,000 square feet of temperature-controlled warehouse space, supported by a fleet of multi-temperature trailers. Its services include cross-docking, trans-shipments, and just-in-time delivery, with a recently completed distribution facility in Southern California expanding its reach.

Alpine serves food manufacturers, distributors, and foodservice operators throughout the Pacific Northwest and beyond. Its customer base includes suppliers seeking broader market access and distributors needing reliable, flexible redistribution with lower minimum order requirements.

The company emphasizes transparent, honest support and a flexible approach to order management, positioning itself as a partner that reduces supply-chain complexity while offering competitive pricing and personalized service.

name: Alpine Home Medical
old_description: Alpine Home Medical has been helping families across Idaho get the home medical equipment they need since 1997. For anyone searching for Idaho Falls medical supplies, our store carries one of the most thorough inventories in eastern Idaho, with everything available to purchase or rent depending on what fits your situation and your budget.
about:
Alpine Home Medical operates from Idaho Falls, Idaho, where it was founded in 1997. The company began as a local supplier of home medical equipment and has since expanded to multiple locations across Idaho and Utah, including Logan, Ogden, and Salt Lake City. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks and rents a broad range of durable medical equipment, including power lift chairs, hospital beds, mobility scooters, power wheelchairs, CPAP and BiPAP machines, oxygen concentrators, cold therapy units, compression socks, and daily living aids. It offers both purchase and short-term rental options, with weekly or monthly terms, and provides delivery throughout eastern Idaho, including rural communities up to 30 miles from Idaho Falls. The Idaho Falls team assists customers with product selection, insurance verification, and equipment setup.

Alpine serves patients recovering from orthopedic procedures at Eastern Idaho Regional Medical Center (EIRMC), as well as individuals managing chronic respiratory conditions, mobility limitations, and post-surgical recovery. Customers include seniors aging in place, seasonal agricultural workers needing temporary support, and caregivers across Bonneville County and surrounding areas such as Ammon, Pocatello, Rexburg, and Blackfoot. The company accepts Medicare, Aetna, PEHP, Optum, Cigna, and HSA/FSA cards.

The company emphasizes personalized service, with staff walking customers through options and coordinating delivery timing around patient schedules. Its rental program addresses temporary needs, and the team handles insurance paperwork to reduce out-of-pocket uncertainty.

The company distributes a comprehensive inventory of home medical equipment and supplies, including incontinence products, mobility devices, power mobility devices, and bathroom safety durable medical equipment (DME). Amador Medical maintains most items in stock and offers immediate delivery, with same-day service available for local customers.

Its customer base includes individuals with temporary or ongoing medical conditions, caregivers, and community partners throughout Southern Nevada and Idaho. The company emphasizes personalized attention and compassionate support, aiming to enable clients to receive care outside of hospital environments.

Amador Medical states that compassion is its company motto and that carrying high-quality products at affordable prices builds trust within the communities it serves. The business was started to meet budget needs and guarantee satisfaction for those requiring medical supplies and equipment.

name: Ambix Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Since 2001, Ambix has been a leader in high-end plastics injection design, molding, and contract manufacturing transforming customer’s challenges into gains.
about:
Ambix Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 2001 in Albany, New Hampshire. The company operates as a full-service provider of custom plastic injection molding, offering design, mold building, prototyping, and contract manufacturing.

Ambix delivers end-to-end plastics manufacturing, from material selection and mold design through prototyping, process development, and high-volume production. The shop runs high-temperature molding and precision machining, and provides value-added services such as small-parts packing, sorting, and bagging in bulk or retail configurations. The company has produced millions of parts across numerous mold designs, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Ambix serves customers facing supply-chain risk, quality issues, budget constraints, and demand surges. Case studies reference clients who on-shored production to the New Hampshire plant, reduced mold costs through interchangeable components, and secured raw materials during extended lead-time periods. Specific industry sectors are not named in the company’s public materials.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround on prototypes, molds, and production runs, with a focus on first-time quality and ISO 9000:2015 certification. Ambix differentiates itself through process optimization, failure analysis, automation integration, and a strong vendor network that enables domestic manufacturing and cost reduction.
